description: A dead room is bad for business, so the bars pay bodies to look like regulars. Fill a stool at the Dead Pigeon, then again at Sump. Nurse one drink. Laugh at the right times. 20₵.
name: Seat Filler

objectives.desc: Warm a stool at the Dead Pigeon
emotes: {who} settles onto a stool at the Dead Pigeon and makes one flat drink last a very long time.
{who} laughs too loud at nothing, selling the impression of a place worth being.
{who} nods along to a stranger's story, contributing the vital illusion of an audience.
{who} slides onto a bench at Sump and immediately looks like they've been coming here for years.
{who} raises a glass to no one, keeping the place feeling half-alive on franchise credits.
{who} pretends to read a sticky menu at Sump, the very picture of a satisfied regular.
